_doc: 鹿历险记统一生图/入库规格。吸收 XRKbar/sprite-animator（4×4 定格、同角色一致性）与 spritebrew（#FF00FF 幕、NEAREST、边溢色清理、画格占比）。Godot 槽位以 GameConstants / character.json 为准；本文件管 AI 与 process_*。改尺寸后必须 reimport。

pixel.cook: BOX → quantize(no dither) → fringe → despill → NEAREST×px

screen.margin_note: 生图角色约占格60%，均匀居中留白方便裁；跳跃用姿态表高度勿顶格；特效可用非幕色

sprite_animator.template: solid screen fill only; math virtual equal cells; no borders/labels/guides
sprite_animator.style_tag: match confirmed idle pixel base; soft cel chibi
sprite_animator.rule: template(screen only) + cutout style + idle pose lock → one fill → extract → process_character
forbid: ad-hoc single frames without idle lock
grey/black cell bg when screen is magenta
magenta or #FF00FF on character body (hood eyes, trim, etc.)
sprite_animator.note: 仅作生帧前端；入库前必须 process_character + pixel_matte。详见 deer-ai-pixel-pipeline §0.5

spritebrew.animate: Animate My Character = upload confirmed pixel base then walk/jump/attack
spritebrew.note: 第三方；不进本仓。导出后走本仓 cook

scroll.note: 王美嘉弹：短飞后悬浮旋转 AoE

ai.style: high-res sharp illustration NOT pixel art; hard-pixel in Python
prompt_must: TWO nearly identical ultra-wide banners STACKED
no characters no UI no text no sunflowers focus

cook.note: frame @2x 高=720 对齐 VIEW_H，避免局内二次放大发糊；宽度随原图，不强制超宽裁切

ai.style: high-res sharp illustration NOT pixel art; flat orthographic 2D side-view; hard-pixel later in Python
prompt_common: ONE single asset centered, large margin ≥8%
flat orthographic side-view, NO 3/4 perspective, NO isometric
no characters, no UI, no text, no second object

must: grass or surface material ONLY on the TOP strip
soil/stone fills the rest of the square
ONE wide short HORIZONTAL ribbon only
grass/moss/leaf edge strip, much wider than tall
NOT a vertical pillar, NOT a square block
ONE wide short rectangular platform SIDE VIEW
plank or stone ledge from the side
flat top edge, full rectangular body
NOT 3/4 view, NOT floating island with hanging underside

themes.meadow: sunny meadow — bright green grass, warm brown soil, light wood
themes.orchard: fruit orchard — mossy green, rich soil, leaf flecks, weathered wood
themes.creek: cool creek — teal moss, wet dark soil, pebbles, gray stone ledge
themes.dusk: maple dusk — autumn orange litter, reddish soil, dark warm wood
themes.cliff: rocky cliff — gray stone, sparse moss, cool dirt, stone ledge
